articles.title: Dive Into the Deep: Watch a Live Ocean Exploration Today
articles.summary: A robot is diving 3.5 miles down in the Pacific, and you can watch it live today at 5:30 p.m. EDT. The NOAA ship Okeanos is exploring near the Cook Islands to help map the seafloor and understand deep-sea ecosystems. Don't miss the livestream!

articles.title: Two New Chemical Tools Could Unlock Alzheimer's Secrets
articles.summary: Scientists created two new compounds that can control a protein linked to Alzheimer's. One blocks TAOK-1, the other activates all TAOK proteins. These tools could help researchers understand the disease better and develop new treatments. A big step toward a cure!

articles.title: Neptune's Moons May Be the Shattered Remains of a Cosmic Collision
articles.summary: Three of Neptune's moons might be made from pieces of ancient icy worlds destroyed by Triton, Neptune's largest moon. The James Webb Space Telescope found clay minerals on them, suggesting a catastrophic crash. This could give us a rare look inside icy moons.
